parsed_json.up: Select IC50 activity rows for human sodium-dependent dopamine transporter (CHEMBL238). Join molecule_dictionary to activities, then to assays and target_dictionary, filtering by target CHEMBL238 and standard_type IC50. Join compound_records on activities.record_id for compound_key and docs on doc_id to derive pubmed_id_or_doi (prefer pubmed_id, fallback to doi). Join compound_structures on molregno for canonical_smiles (INNER JOIN required). Return columns compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism. Keep all activity rows; do not deduplicate. Sort by compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism.
